profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer | AWS, Node.js, Java, .Net | Specialist in Robust System Integrations, Distributed Systems & Scalable AWS Solutions
profile.summary:
I operate on a simple principle: true engineering value lives at the intersection of technical mastery, human leadership, and deep business empathy.
Throughout my career, I have used this framework to transform complex distributed systems, pay down architectural debt, and bridge the gap between business strategy and highly reliable code.

My expertise spans the Java, Node.js, and .NET ecosystems, with a deep focus on cloud native architectures (AWS) and robust, asynchronous system integrations. I thrive in high-stakes environments where security, compliance, and zero-downtime workflows are non-negotiable.

 -- My Technical Expertise & Core Stack --
Architecture & Scale: Distributed Systems, Event-Driven Architecture, Microservices, API Design, High-Availability Systems.
Ecosystems & Cloud: AWS (Core Services & Serverless), Java, Node.js, .NET, PostgreSQL.
Methodologies & Leadership: Scrum/Agile, Cross-Functional Coordination, Requirements Mapping, Mentorship.

 -- Featured Impact of my work --
Most recently, I led the architectural overhaul of the core process and technical execution of an international, FDA-regulated IVD medical device software ecosystem. Stepping into a dual role as Architect/System Designer and de facto Product Owner, I unraveled a decade of legacy technical debt and mapped complex requirements across the entire organization. We successfully re-architected the core workflow application and pushed the new system into production in just 5 months—completely on time, fully compliant, and with zero disruption to the production workflow.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Scaled medical interpretation capacity 3x, while adding resilience and robustness, by redesigning and maintaining a critical part of an application suite that supports an innovative insights generation workflow. 

Reduced time-to-market for new requirements by 60%, and eliminated production errors of a regulated system, by streamlining its new requirements development process, and creating software tools (e.g. IDE extensions and CI/CD integrations) that automate manual steps and verification steps.

positions.title: Tech lead and Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Tech Lead and Senior Software Developer for a biotechnology company in USA (Foundation Medicine), delivering critical and constant value to a business core, through a family of web APIs, web apps, its integrations, and providing technical guidance.
Main hard skills: NodeJS, up-to-date .NET, messaging and other enterprise integrations, Amazon Web Services, PostgreSQL, MS SQL Server.

positions.title: Development Leader and Cofounder
positions.description:
Tech Lead and software architect of several projects for different companies, notably a few rich internet apps, and a big scale project for the state government.
Cofounder.
Microsoft C# and Silverlight instructor. I provided professional training in Software development, using technologies like Microsoft C#, Silverlight, ASP.NET MVC, Borland/Embarcadero Delphi, and MS SQL Server.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Implementation of core software components for the new Messaging-Oriented Middleware and Enterprise Service Bus, as well as a important set of enterprise-grade web services, part of the digital transformation of the international non-profit organization (Compassion International)
Using C#, ASP.NET MVC, MSMQ, Silverlight, Neuron ESB.

company.name: Cibernética de México, SA de CV

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Application and Integrations Development. Empowered the company, which was experiencing an explosive growth, by updating and upgrading legacy applications, and developing integrations with customer systems (mainly government).

Stack: Borland/CodeGear Delphi and .Net (C#), plus a series of integration technologies like XML, SOAP, TCP sockets, javascript, ASP.Net, PHP, etc.
Mastering of different databases like Advantage DB, MS SQL Server, and MySQL.

positions.title: Systems and Support Engineer
positions.description: Implementation and support of local and regional infrastructure (Windows and Linux servers, devices and networking), application and database support for Healthcare systems (Laboratory and blood bank) for multiple facilities in both public and private sectors.
